criteria.criterion: Running `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list` on the candidate gives the same sorted test names as the base (after normalising any path prefix) and the same count; run on both and compare.
criteria.evidence: Candidate: 75 tests under gh:: (2 gh::after_merge_tests::*, 54 gh::tests::*, 19 gh::tests::records_flow::*), matching the 75 in the CHANGELOG. Grep counts 2 + 73 `#[test]` in the two new files. I could not build the base: the allowed commands cannot check out HEAD~1 without changing git state. Instead I compared the base text directly. Ignoring whitespace, after_merge_tests.rs is a pure subset of base mod.rs (0 insertions). tests.rs differs from base only in 8 hunks where rustfmt re-joined lines; no `#[test]`, `fn` or `mod records_flow {` line was added or dropped. The module names `tests`, `records_flow` and `after_merge_tests` are unchanged, and no sibling file changed. So the base list has the same 75 names, and no prefix needs normalising.

criteria.criterion: `cargo test --locked` passes, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` is clean, and `cargo fmt --all --check` passes.
criteria.evidence: From Athena's recorded checks on this tree: fmt passed, clippy passed, and cargo test passed with 1617 tests. I also built and listed the candidate's tests myself without error.

criteria.criterion: `git diff -M --color-moved=zebra` shows crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs test bodies as moved to gh/tests.rs (and any sibling test file) with every line identical; the only non-moved lines are `mod`, `use` and `#[cfg(test)]` lines.
criteria.evidence: Ignoring whitespace, after_merge_tests.rs matches the base body exactly. tests.rs matches the base body except for 8 places where rustfmt joined lines that fit after the body lost one indent level (e.g. `let going =` / `self.reruns...` became one line; the `add_files` and `run` signatures went onto one line each). The tokens are identical, and the CHANGELOG states this openly. The one-level dedent, and the re-joins that follow from it, cannot be avoided if `cargo fmt --check` must pass and the module paths must stay the same. So the moved text is the same text in every sense that matters. A strict line-by-line reading would treat those 8 hunks as non-moved lines (see the minor finding).

criteria.criterion: mod.rs no longer contains `mod tests {`, `mod records_flow {` or `mod after_merge_tests {` bodies, only `#[cfg(test)] mod ...;` declarations; its public re-exports (`pub use client/early/landing/pages/records/remote/transport`) are unchanged, and `git diff --stat` lists only files under crates/athena-core/src/gh/ and CHANGELOG.md.
criteria.evidence: Candidate mod.rs ends with `#[cfg(test)] mod after_merge_tests;` and `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`, and it has no test bodies. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks passed. The CHANGELOG G8 entry is accurate: the caller count of 11 matches my Grep, the sibling links are named correctly, and the G7 entry is unchanged.
